revision.description: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON of this object without `revision`

wifi.description: false = lock Wi-Fi settings (not the radio)

wifiRadio.description: 1.4: false = radio off, true = radio on

locationServices.description: 1.6: Android 11+ Device Owner, false = Location services off, true = on; locked while managed

policies.description: Only keys the configuration manages are present. true = allowed/enabled.

kiosk.description: Present => ensure kiosk with this KioskApplyPayload. Absent = the configuration does not assert kiosk; the agent exits only if the previously applied configuration document had kiosk.

allowedPackages.description: The configuration's apps set to Install with "Show in kiosk" on (showIcon); the main app is pinned only under the same rule.

lockButtons.description: true = block the power menu (no LOCK_TASK_FEATURE_GLOBAL_ACTIONS); does not touch volume

lockVolume.description: 1.4: true = DISALLOW_ADJUST_VOLUME while in kiosk (the platform mutes the device meanwhile); released on exit

backgroundImage.description: Agent 0.5.0: an image the server hosts, drawn behind the launcher. Sent only for a configuration's uploaded image (PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 10 MB and 16 megapixels, checked on save). The agent downloads it over HTTPS only, checks the SHA-256 and the size, and keeps backgroundColor on any failure. Older agents ignore it.

sha256.description: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file

mode.description: active = fresh fix each check-in (GPS), passive = last-known (console: Last known (passive), formerly Network), off = read no location (Do not track; 1.4, older agents treat it as passive and the server drops what they report)

dns.description: 1.6: global Private DNS host (or IP). Present = managed; an empty string clears it back to opportunistic mode. Absent = the configuration never set one (the agent leaves the current mode alone). Older agents ignore it.

mode.description: 1.5: the live-connection mode, the same modes as device.powerMode. adaptive = hold the wake socket only while the screen is on or charging (battery-saver, the agent default); alwaysOn = hold it 24/7. Absent = not managed (the device keeps its mode). Older agents ignore it.

appPermissions.description: Optional per-application runtime permission overrides. Omitted means an older server does not manage this section; an empty list releases every prior MDMesh override.
